author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 18th of May of 2025. Around noontime, I walked to Tim Hortons café to enjoy an Iced Coffee with oat milk. On the way, I saw my neighbour friend Rod washing his big camper, as he and his Ukrainian-descent star-savvy wife Joanne intend to camp in Okanagan. The café was really crowded, this Sunday. The long table with an ice hockey rink drawn thereon was full of Orientals: Two Japanese, one in black and one in beige, and the rest were Cantonese. The sky was clearing, with more blue, and the temperature was rising.

text: 今日係2025年5月18號。大約喺晏晝，我行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，享用一杯燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡。途中，我見到我鄰居朋友 Rod 洗緊佢架大露營車，因為佢同佢烏克蘭血統嘅明星老婆 Joanne 打算喺奧卡納根露營。途中，我見到我嘅鄰居朋友 Rod 洗緊佢架大露營車，因為佢同佢烏克蘭血統嘅明星老婆 Joanne 打算喺奧肯那根露營充滿東方人：兩個日本人，一個係黑色，一個係米色，其餘都係香港人。天空晴朗，藍色更多，氣溫亦都上升緊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I count not riches as doth the common sort, / nor do I prize the English tongue above all. / For though the isle of Albion vaunt her speech, / and Nippon dreameth of wedlock with the West, / I hold my treasure in a wider store. / The songs of Spain, of France, of Portugal, / of Catalan, Italia, Chabacano, / with Esperanto and Lojban twain, / do weave a garland fair of southern fire. / Yet turn I also eastward, where the dawn / in Orient tongues doth clothe the soul with light— / Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, / and Vietnam's sweet flowing words of jade. / But richest still the tongues that earth forgot, / the songs of elder tribes, Aboriginal, / Amerindian, whose breath is spirit's root, / more precious far than gold of any crown. / Thus is my wealth not coin nor empty fame, / but in the rainbow'd speech of humankind, / where East and West together find their peace, / and every voice is kin unto mine own.

text: 我唔會好似一般人噉計財富， / 我亦都唔會將英文嘅語言放喺最重要嘅位置。 / 因為雖然阿爾比安島吹噓佢嘅演講， / 而日本夢想同西方結婚， / 我將我嘅寶藏放喺一個更廣闊嘅商店入面。 / 西班牙、法國、葡萄牙、 / 加泰羅尼亞、意大利、查巴卡諾嘅歌曲， / 同世界語同洛伊班雙胞胎一齊， / 織出一個南方火嘅花環市集。 / 但係我亦都向東轉，喺嗰度，黎明 / 喺東方語言入面，為靈魂披上光 — / 日文、韓文、中文、粵文、泰文同越南文嘅甜美流動嘅玉語。 / 但最豐富嘅仍然係地球忘記咗嘅語言， / 長老部落嘅歌曲，原住民， / 美洲印第安人，佢哋嘅呼吸係靈魂嘅根源， / 珍貴過任何皇冠嘅金。 / 所以我嘅財富唔係硬幣，亦唔係空虛嘅名氣， / 而係喺人類嘅彩虹般嘅說話入面， / 東西方一齊搵到佢哋嘅和平， / 而每一把聲都係我自己嘅親戚。
